description: fz-go4.19's duplication inventory (2026-07-03, at bcc1ac3d0) found a THIRD near-verbatim copy of the product pull-drive loop as test scaffolding in src/compiler2/transport_contract_test.rs — drive_root_backend_product_for_test / pull_product_until_produced_with_fact_waits / drive_product_fact_wait_for_test / product_fact_wait_is_satisfied_for_test (~lines 4558-4644 at that commit; panic-based instead of Result-based). Production copies were unified into compiler2::product_drive (ProductDriveError trait, fz-go4.19); evaluate whether the test scaffold can consume the shared runner via a panic-based ProductDriveError impl instead of keeping a fork. (The by-cover selection idiom duplication originally also tracked here was extracted at the fz-go4.18.28.15 fold — two_executables_covered_by_one_solve — and is no longer part of this ticket.) Test-only, two-lane audit.
title: Dedup transport_contract_test.rs scaffolding: third drive-loop copy + by-cover selection idiom
